g.text: Exact Mann–Whitney null for 5 deleterious vs 3 neutral: 56 equally likely rankings. Even a perfect ranking gives p = 0.018,

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: well above the Bonferroni bar for the 45 readouts tested (0.05 / 45 = 0.0011).
